notes.title: Development Office Letter No. 10 About Text Writing
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Suzuki, a producer at LOST EPIC.
One more day! Soon "LOST EPIC" will switch from "Early Access" to "Full Release".
The PS version will be released at the same time.
It's been almost a year since we started "Early Access" and we are very sorry for the long wait!
Today, we received comments from the text writing staff.
----------------------------------
Nice to meet you all!
I am Akasaka, a planner at Studio One or Eight.
I was mainly in charge of text writing for "LOST EPIC.

I would say that I was in charge of text writing, but there were drafts of the worldview, character settings, storyline, etc. that were created by "Shitamachi Games".
I wrote the text for the dialogue, equipment, etc. that would appear in the game based on these drafts.

Lost Epic" is a fast-paced action game, so I didn't want to disturb the tempo of the game too much.
I tried not to make the conversations with the characters too long.
I tried not to make the conversations with the characters too long, but I also tried to write the story in such a way that the characters' personalities are expressed and the story does not become confusing.
I tried to write the game in such a way that the characters' personalities would be expressed and the story would not become confusing.
I would be happy if you could find the characters you are interested in.

And since it's no fun to just talk about the ending, I'll tell you a little bit about the ending... but don't worry, I won't spoil it for you!
Actually, "LOST EPIC" has an ending story that I proposed at the end of the development.
However, the timing of the proposal was not good, and it is now a phantom ending (lol).
I am dreaming that I would be happy if it would be implemented at some point in the future. ............

Last but not least, the official release of "LOST EPIC" is just around the corner!
I will be playing online after the release, and I am looking forward to fighting alongside you as a knight.
See you all next time in the Divine Realm! May the old gods bless you all...

notes.title: Development Office Letter No. 9 About Level Design
notes.content:

Only 2 more days until the full release!

----------------------------------

Nice to meet you all!
My name is Yanase, a planner at Studio One or Eight!
I am a planner at Studio One or Eight, and I assisted in the level design of "LOST EPIC".

I helped with the level design of "Lost Epic", including the terrain and composition of the House of Salvation and Borderlands fields, as well as adjusting the placement of enemies.
(The concept of each field and the final adjustments were made by Downtown Games.)

The maps before that were created by Shitamachi Games, so we had to make sure that there were as few differences as possible from the maps created by them, and since they were maps for the latter half of the game, we had to be careful not to get bored with them and make them less boring. I had to make it so that it would not be boring. I was in agony thinking about the terrain and the placement of the enemies.
I remember playing NEW GAME to the underground world over and over again, talking about this and that, and designing the levels in my dreams... (laughs). (laugh).

Well, I've talked about my memories of those days for a long time, but I'll leave it at that.
After more than a year of "LOST EPIC" Early Access, the game is now officially released!
The official release of "LOST EPIC" will include end content that I helped with, so I hope you are looking forward to it!

Thank you for your continued support of "LOST EPIC"!"

notes.title: ""News from the Development Office"" No. 5
notes.content:
Thank you for playing and supporting LOST EPIC.
I am the Environment Artist  for the game.
In this issue of Development Room News, I'd like to mix things up a bit and talk about the game lore.

I would like to talk about the topic I would like to cover this time is ""What do The Holy Ones eat?""
The Holy Ones are the chosen ones who live in the God's domain, but they still need to consume food to sustain their lives."
"As a knight, you may have encountered a variety of insects that inhabit the sanctuary during your exploration.
In fact, these insects are the food of The Holy Ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/bd238272f515737381360c1d19b6235a3e969c79.jpg[/img]

The insects that inhabit the sanctuary differ from those of the real world in that their ecology is similar to that of plants until they hatch.
In beetle grass, the insects start their life as flowers and after the fruit has fully matured, they turn into insects.
When the fruit matures, the insect disperses to different parts of the world with its wings, carrying pollen on its own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39077735/351dd30c76e5e85c49ebe10474c48cf07ebcfd59.png[/img]

The Holy Ones harvest the ripe fruit just before the insects fly away as food.
The berries grown as insects are the most nutritious and can be secured in large quantities at a time.
They are said to eat them in a variety of ways, including baking, boiling, and steaming, as an exquisite dish with an exquisite aroma.

In addition to those introduced here, there are many other insects that appear in LOST EPIC.

notes.title: About the key configuration bug
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your help.

We have received reports of a bug in the key configuration where the "Weak Attack" and "Decision" keys are set to the same key, causing the player to be unable to proceed from the title screen.

　Delete the file "Steam\userdata\userid\1426490\remote\Config.dat".
The "userid" is the userid of the Steam client you are using.

Open the LOSTEPIC properties in the Steam client and uncheck the "Save Lost Epic Games to Steam Cloud" checkbox.

4. Quit LOSTEPIC, turn on the "Save LOST EPIC game to Steam Cloud" checkbox you removed in [2], and quit Steam client as well.

If you start up the Steam client again, the configuration data will be in a modified state.

Also, in some UIs, the "Decision" and "Cancel" configurations were not reflected, and the default operation was used.

Local saves are saved at the timing of area switching and overwrite the 10 saved data in the oldest order.
By loading a local save, you can easily start over from the point where you entered the area, or go back to a situation before you died.
